d:
Mokama ke purv vidhayak aur bahubli neta anant sinh (chhote sarkar) ki beti shivangi ki shadi ka jashn shuru ho chuka hai. is shahi shadi ke mukhy aakarshanon men se ek 'bhavy ghurdaur' (Horse Racing) pratiyogita ke lie desh ke alag-alag rajyon se nami ghore aur ghurasvar mokama pahunchne lage hain.
Banaras se pahunche do resing ghore
